# rate_cycle_episodes raw output (generated by scripts/tests/rate_cycle_episodes.py)

## 0. DATA AND SETUP
KSE100 data/macro/kse100.csv: 2480 rows 2016-10-17 to 2026-10-16. Trading calendar = these dates. Last close 166419.72.
KSE100 type: PSX KSE-100 is a free-float market-cap PRICE index (capital gains only, no dividends); the file has OHLCV only and no dividend column. Treated as a price index, no dividends added (lesson 19). [type from PSX index methodology, not verifiable inside the file]
Price panel: prices.load_panel() 2480 dates x 456 symbols. Liquid universe: trailing 60 sessions strictly before t0, median traded value > Rs5m, 40+ obs (vector mask checked equal to prices.liquid_universe on 4 dates).
Flag matrices: suspected log rows 801 (suspected_corporate_actions.csv), candidate-bonus day count 3110, provisional actions 462 (bonus/split 12, cash 450).
Flag B = suspected log OR candidate bonus (-8% to -10.5%, vol ratio<=3, price>Rs10) OR provisional bonus/split ex-date inside the window. Flag A = B plus provisional CASH dividend ex-dates (spec-literal; flags most payers). EWX = EW excluding flag-B names; EWA = EW with method='adjusted', actions=provisional_actions() (TOTAL return incl. cash dividends, so not like-for-like with price-only KSE100); EWAX = EWA excluding flag-B names.
EW survivorship: panel holds only symbols listed on 2026-10-16 (456 of 528 seed files non-empty), delisted losers missing, EW biased UP.
Cost: 0.5% round trip subtracted from every trade-framed row (net = gross - 0.5%). Placebo: 10000 draws of k dates with replacement, fixed seed 17102026, t0 from 2016-10-18, complete windows only; EW placebos also need >=10 basket names (EWX/EWAX >=5).
Entry t0 = close of the first trading day strictly after the announcement date. Return = close[t0+h]/close[t0]-1. Windows past 2026-10-16 are shown INCOMPLETE with the return to date and are never used in statistics.
placebo date pool KSE h=20: 2459 dates (2016-10-18 to 2026-09-18), unconditional single-date median +1.1%, mean +1.3%, win 57%
placebo date pool EW h=20: 2420 dates (2016-12-13 to 2026-09-18), unconditional single-date median +0.4%, mean +0.8%, win 53%
placebo date pool KSE h=60: 2419 dates (2016-10-18 to 2026-07-22), unconditional single-date median +2.2%, mean +4.1%, win 59%
placebo date pool EW h=60: 2380 dates (2016-12-13 to 2026-07-22), unconditional single-date median +0.4%, mean +2.6%, win 51%
placebo date pool KSE h=120: 2359 dates (2016-10-18 to 2026-04-21), unconditional single-date median +3.3%, mean +8.4%, win 58%
placebo date pool EW h=120: 2320 dates (2016-12-13 to 2026-04-21), unconditional single-date median +1.4%, mean +5.6%, win 51%
placebo date pool KSE h=250: 2229 dates (2016-10-18 to 2025-10-15), unconditional single-date median +7.4%, mean +20.3%, win 59%
placebo date pool EW h=250: 2190 dates (2016-12-13 to 2025-10-15), unconditional single-date median +0.2%, mean +14.9%, win 50%

## H2: the first cut of a cycle is strongest

### H2: first cut vs later cuts in the same cycle (cycle = until the next hike)
| cycle | first move | series | h | first move return | median of later moves in cycle | rank of first (1=best) | first minus later median |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## H4: CPI fall of 1pt+ over 3 months leads to +44% over the next 12 months (and mirror: CPI rise)
Signal at month m: yoy(m) - yoy(m-3) <= -1.0 (mirror >= +1.0). yoy = yoy_pbs_release where present else seed yoy (source printed). 2026-09 (10.3) excluded as unverified. Formation t0 = first trading day after the 5th of month m+1. VINTAGE CAVEAT: series is rebased to 2015-16 retroactively (PBS rebased in 2020) so pre-2020 values are not the real-time vintage; not fixed.

## H5: the market anticipates cuts through T-bills (6M cut-off yield vs prevailing policy rate)
Prevailing rate = rate of the latest MPC announcement strictly before the auction. Auctions before 2015-01-31 use rate - change = 9.5 (derived from the first row; unverified). Auctions 308, with blank y6m 38.
Fixed in advance: primary threshold 0bp; sensitivities 50bp, 100bp, 2 consecutive auctions. No others.
2015 cut cycle: not computable (first cut 2015-01-31 has no preceding hike cycle in the data and no earlier T-bill history; KSE100 also starts 2016-10-17).

### Corporate-action handling: basket composition and sensitivity at the cluster-first cuts (120d)
Flag components among the liquid names at t0 (names with at least one such day in the 120d window; a name can sit in several):
| cut | suspected-log days | candidate-bonus days (loose rule, flags many ordinary -8..-10% days) | provisional bonus/split ex-dates | provisional cash-dividend ex-dates (flag A only) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2020-03-17 | 2 | 4 | 0 | 0 |
| 2024-06-10 | 5 | 30 | 0 | 4 |
| 2025-12-15 | 6 | 152 | 0 | 42 |

| cut | liquid names | flag-B names | flag-A names | EW (crude) | EWX (crude, ex flag B) | EWA (adjusted, provisional actions, total return) | EWAX (adjusted ex flag B) | KSE100 price |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2020-03-17 | 81 | 6 | 6 | +74.6% | +73.5% | +74.6% | +73.5% | +39.8% |
| 2024-06-10 | 118 | 34 | 37 | +49.2% | +44.1% | +49.5% | +44.4% | +49.1% |
| 2025-12-15 | 196 | 152 | 162 | -7.0% | -8.8% | -6.4% | -8.3% | +1.1% |

Baskets dilute but do not remove the bonus bias: one 10% bonus (about -9.1% fake loss) in an n-name basket costs 9.1/n pts, e.g. 1.8 pts in a 5-name basket. EW/EWX are price-only after crude zeroing; EWA adds cash dividends back (total return); lesson 19 respected (no extra yield added).
